rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The summary reports one occurrence each for availability heuristic, satisficing, and confirmation bias, matching the three identified occurrence records; one candidate is separately reported.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The sister-unit story, honestly... So I moved it up.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant elevates FW-IV-204 because a vivid sister-unit failure outweighed flat local CR and trend evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I looked at the first configuration that met minimum schedule and safety requirements... and locked it in.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Under a one-hour deadline and limited processing capacity, the participant selects the first satisfactory crew configuration instead of comparing feasible alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: They looked consistent with that, so I documented the anomaly as resolved... I didn't feel a need to widen the search.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant requests theory-consistent vibration data and omits available lubrication and full-trend records that could disconfirm misalignment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Given the sign-offs and what I observed directly during the walkdown, I concurred with return to service.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Formal engineering concurrence, closed CRs, and a direct walkdown provide a documented non-biased basis for concurrence.

segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Availability heuristic is an established equivalent of the hidden Availability Bias label; the mechanism and location are fully supported.

segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The low-confidence identified finding is excluded from the first two thresholds. It is a segment hit once low-confidence identified findings are included, despite its near-neighbor label.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_003 quotes the misalignment-consistent data request and the explicit decision not to widen the search.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Confirmation bias is an exact target-label and full-mechanism match.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Priority ranking of FW-IV-204 during pre-outage scoping
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Recall vividness of a memorable sister-unit valve failure inflates perceived risk of local, statistically unremarkable valve issue, overriding documented trend data during priority ranking.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is an established scholarly alternate name for availability bias, and the stated mechanism exactly matches the hidden vivid-recall overweighting during priority ranking.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding identifies the vivid sister-unit failure, its inflated risk weight over flat local trend data, and the work-order priority operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted participant evidence is valid, directly attributable, and substantively overlaps the mapped span.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Crew configuration selection for FW-IV-204 under time pressure
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Time- and capacity-constrained selection of the first satisfactory crew configuration instead of continued search for an optimal one.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Satisficing names the first-acceptable-option strategy, which is the manifested mechanism, but it is a related decision strategy rather than an approved equivalent of the hidden Bounded Rationality construct.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures the time-limited first-satisfactory choice and the resource-allocation operation, so the mechanism-first scorecard credits it.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The two quoted participant passages validly support the choice rule, time constraint, and available alternatives.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Evaluation of post-maintenance pump bearing vibration anomaly
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Selective solicitation and interpretation of vibration data consistent with a pre-formed misalignment theory, while not requesting available disconfirming lubrication/trend records.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The predicted label exactly matches the hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding identifies the pre-formed misalignment theory, selective theory-consistent readings, and omission of available lubrication and trend evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted passages are valid and directly support the mapped diagnostic evidence-selection rationale.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The candidate is localized to the neutral return-to-service segment and has no relation to any hidden bias mechanism; the interview supplies a documented non-bias basis of engineering concurrence, closed CRs, and a clean walkdown.

candidates.details: The candidate is a cautious near-hypothesis with a valid quote, but the participant's sign-off-supported decision has a plausible non-bias explanation and does not establish schedule-driven irrational continuation.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Detected the availability and confirmation segments; bounded-rationality segment was missed because its identified finding was low confidence.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Same as high_only because no moderate-confidence findings were present.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All three positive segments were detected with no false alarms when low-confidence identified findings were included.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: All positive segments remained detected, but the neutral return-to-service candidate became one false alarm.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the hidden first-satisfactory-choice mechanism, but the label is a related strategy rather than the hidden target construct.
No overlap with the three hidden mechanisms; the candidate is attached to a neutral return-to-service judgment.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: obs_003 claims retrieved support and supplies an OCR-corrupted passage with incomplete bibliographic metadata; obs_001 and obs_002 explicitly disclose no retrieved mechanism support. No independent retrieval log or corpus package was supplied, so fidelity is not scored.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: No change: no moderate-confidence findings were present.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence satisficing finding detects the bounded-rationality segment and raises mechanism-first instance F1 from 0.8000 to 1.0000, while strict F1 falls from 0.8000 to 0.6667 because the label is a near neighbor.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding the plan-continuation candidate creates one false alarm on the neutral segment; strict F1 falls to 0.5714 and mechanism-first F1 to 0.8571.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 2 of 3 positive segments were detected with no false alarms; the low-confidence finding is needed to detect the third.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Availability and confirmation are exact or approved-equivalent matches. The bounded-rationality mechanism is localized and complete but labeled satisficing, producing one strict false positive and one strict false negative when low confidence is included.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: All three hidden mechanisms are recovered exactly once at the all_identified_confidence_levels threshold; the candidate adds one false alarm at the fourth threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention rationale in the analysis text, but candidate-inclusive scoring still counts it as a false alarm because it localizes to the neutral segment.
main_failure_modes: Low confidence on the bounded-rationality finding delays detection at the recommended threshold.
The satisficing label is a near neighbor rather than the hidden Bounded Rationality target, lowering strict precision and recall.
The candidate plan-continuation hypothesis is counted as a false alarm on the neutral return-to-service segment.
main_strengths: Availability and confirmation findings use valid, mechanism-specific evidence at the correct segments.
The bounded-rationality mechanism is correctly captured despite taxonomy mismatch.
The candidate record explicitly preserves a plausible non-bias explanation rather than promoting it to an identified finding.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong mechanism recovery when low-confidence findings are admitted, with a taxonomy and confidence tradeoff: strict label scoring penalizes the satisficing near neighbor, and candidate inclusion adds a neutral-segment false alarm.
